text:
You're not getting rejected. You're getting outranked.

Every woman is built to go for the best guy she can get.

Not the most desperate. Not the nicest to her.

The best.

If you want a woman at a certain level, you need to be above it. That's the whole game.

A woman's ceiling is mostly set.

Yours isn't.

Men build value through work and results. Every year you grind, you rise. Time works FOR you.

Your job isn't to find the right woman.

It's to become the man she can't ignore.

She's not out of your league. You're just not built yet.
caption:
Discipline and self improvement are the only things that raise your value as a man — your success habits today shape what you attract tomorrow.
